events.title: GummyGom Delivery Is Going Free-to-Play
events.summary: Hello, everyone!This is the GummyGom Delivery Development Team.First of all, we would like to sincerely thank everyone who has shown interest in and supported our game.After careful discussions within our team, we have decided to transition GummyGom Delivery from a paid game to a permanently free title.■ Why We're Making This ChangeOur team has been discussing the future direction of the project, and we believe that making the game freely available will allow more players to enjoy GummyGom Deliv

Fixed an intermittent issue where the camera would become fixed after entering a session and returning to the lobby. events.title: GummyGom Delivery is finally here!
events.summary: Hello, this is NEONORI.After a long wait, the demo version of GummyGom Delivery has finally been released on Steam.In this demo, you can experience the following features:Improved Stages: Refined gameplay environments.Character Customization: Personalize your own character.Achievement System: Three unique achievements to unlock.Important Notice While the game can be played with fewer than 4 players, please note that it may be challenging as the game design and levels are optimized for a 4-player
